name: ATF Demo Resource
description: The relying party of the CSA Verifiable Agent Summit chain. It accepts an AAuth agent token carrying a signed ATF grade, verifies the agent provider and reads the grade the provider vouches for, then decides for itself. `GET /agent/echo` reports what it verified; `GET /api/summarize` applies the same gate and then challenges for a person token, because a qualifying level is eligibility for consideration and not permission.
